label: For "AML Graph Anomaly Detection": Surface layering, structuring and circular fund flows that rule-based monitoring cannot see, cutting false-positive alerts by half. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Random edge split leaks future flows into training.
